settings.question: Can I personalize my gadget?
settings.answer: Yes! Products marked customizable let you add a name or number right on the product page — perfect for the kids' bike moto sign.

settings.question: Do you really sell treasure boxes?
settings.answer: We do! Our 3D-printed treasure boxes are one of our most popular products — find them in the shop alongside signs, desk toys and more.

settings.question: What are your gadgets made of?
settings.answer: Durable, plant-based PLA plastic, 3D-printed in-house. Sturdy, lightweight, and available in a range of colors.

settings.question: Can I request a fully custom design?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Send us your idea through the contact form and we'll see what we can make.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Because gadgets are printed to order, most ship within a few business days. Free shipping on orders over $50.
